description: This file defines the Base64Attachment class, which encapsulates information and operations related to a base64-encoded file attachment, including filename, file type, size, and content, along with methods to create instances from uploaded files or arrays.

classes.name: Base64Attachment
classes.description: A class representing a base64-encoded file attachment with properties like filename, type, size, and content, and providing methods to manipulate and instantiate such objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the Base64Attachment object with filename, file type, base64 content, and size.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Decodes and returns the original content from base64 string.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Encodes and sets the content to base64.

methods.name: createFromUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates a Base64Attachment instance from an UploadedFile object.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a Base64Attachment instance from an associative array.
